name: Sapphire Shores
tagline: Ten Intracoastal residences across the street from the beach
summary: Sapphire Shores is a collection of only 10 brand-new, five-story townhome-style condominiums on the Intracoastal Waterway in Indian Shores, directly across Gulf Boulevard from the beach. Each residence offers five bedrooms plus a den, four baths and more than 4,000 square feet with double rooftop decks. Owners may rent for 1–7 day stays, self-manage or choose a manager, or live there full time.

faqs.q: Can Sapphire Shores be rented short term?
faqs.a: Yes. Sapphire Shores permits 1–7 day rentals. Owners may self-manage or choose any manager, and may also use the home as a full-time residence.

faqs.q: How much is the deposit at Sapphire Shores?
faqs.a: The initial deposit is $10,000 with a total down payment of 20%, subject to the purchase contract.

faqs.q: What financing is available at Sapphire Shores?
faqs.a: Buyers may purchase with cash, conventional, second-home or DSCR financing, subject to lender approval.

faqs.q: When will Sapphire Shores be completed?
What is the projected rental income at Sapphire Shores?
faqs.a: A third-party estimate from Stay Dream Rentals projects approximately $253,000 in annual gross rental revenue per residence. This is an estimate and is not guaranteed.
